profile_headline: Data Scientist | Craves to Learn | Loves to Solve | Lives to teach
post_content:
"Data Science in R"  or "Data Science in Python" or "Machine Learning in R" or
"Machine Learning in Python" I see these names often shared by my students
obtained from online learning platforms asking me which is better. I honestly
feel that these are a bit misleading. Data Science is  a whole ocean of how
you deal with data from visualization and mining to pre-processing followed by
modelling to deployment. At each level, there are many tools which help you
achieve objective Machine Learning is a bunch of mathematical techniques to
solve data related modelling problems. In R or Python ,the math is one and
same.  Learners please note :  Concept should be learnt   Ex : ML, Inferential
Statistics Tool's capability should be assessed and then used to implement
concepts  Ex : R or Python.  Skill should be mastered by  practicing concepts
with help of tools :  Ex : Data Science.  Finally, post should be liked if it
is meaningful :P
